{{Quote|The self-control came easily. Responsibility was&hellip; much more difficult to master. It required that I admit to misdjudging my opponents&hellip; and then resolve to repair the damage done.|Mace Windu|<ref name="Stones" />}}
A '''member''' of a [[Unidentified Hurikane species|rock-encrusted species]] native to the terrestrial body [[Hurikane]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] encountered the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]<ref name="Stones" /> in approximately [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Stones]]" states that [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] [[Mission to Hurikane|travelled]] to [[Hurikane]] when he was fourteen, and [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] states that Windu was born in [[72 BBY/Legends|72 BBY]]. Therefore, his mission to Hurikane and encounter with the [[Unidentified Hurikane species|natives]] must have taken place in approximately [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]].</ref> The creature fell off a cliff while pursuing Windu, upsetting<ref name="Stones" /> his<ref name="CSWE Hurikane" /> companions. Windu regretted his actions and used [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] to [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] the native, for which he was rewarded with [[Hurrikaine crystal]]s, which he used to build his first [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Stones" />
